notes: Model mapping. Diffusion-model ready: (a) PVC cling film DEHA c_P0 = 283,000 mg/kg, L ~14 um (DERIVED), with Goulas cheese and Badeka microwave data as validation; (b) PP/CPP sealant Irgafos 168 c_P0 166-845 mg/kg (n=6) with sealant thickness 12.7-31.8 um (steam bag patent), 60 um (transparent retort PP), 75-87.5 um (foil retort CPP), PP density 0.90 g/cm3 from constants.json. In the Pliant steam-bag design both the sealant and the PP core are polypropylene, so a single PP slab of 32-95 um is a reasonable worst case.
Measurement-based: PAA (4,4'-MDA 2.7-3.1 ug/kg after 121 C 15 min), PU adipate NIAS 0.02-0.2 mg/kg, DEHA/ATBC microwave values (mg/kg food), POSH from microwaved soup cups.

Steam bags reach ~95-102 C food temperature after 4 min (patent Example 1); use T = 100 C and t = 4-6 min in the model, sealant in contact with wet, mostly non-fatty vegetables (aqueous simulant; fat only from butter sauces).

Retort pouches are already heated at 121-135 C for 15-30 min during manufacture, so part of the migration happens before purchase; microwave reheating (1-2 min) adds a smaller increment. No study found that measured migration from a microwaved shelf-stable rice pouch.
No peer-reviewed migration measurement specific to Birds Eye Steamfresh/Green Giant steam bags was found. Treat steam-bag numbers as model estimates from the PP sealant inputs.
DOA in Badeka papers = dioctyl adipate = DEHA (di(2-ethylhexyl) adipate).
Badeka 1996 olive-oil values are mg/L simulant, not mg/kg food; they are much higher than real-food values (51-172 mg/kg). Use food values for the app.

UNVERIFIED / not read: Startin et al. 1987 Food Addit Contam 4(4):385-398 (DEHA from PVC films during home use and microwave cooking) and Castle et al. 1987/1988 parts 2-3; the Taylor & Francis page failed to load and the Europe PMC API returned HTTP 429, so their numbers are not in this file.

Access problems this session: Europe PMC REST API (rate limited, HTTP 429), tandfonline.com (fetch error), EUR-Lex (robots disallowed), publica.fraunhofer.de (access denied). The shared WebSearch budget ran out near the end, so Hussain et al. 2023 (microplastics from microwaved PE food pouches) and EFSA TTC guidance were not checked.
Consumer Reports 1998 DEHA content (0.5-2.2%) disagrees with Goulas 2000 (28.3%). Prefer Goulas for c_P0.
